title: Add profileId to TrackLearningOrder — the one user_database table with a bare autoincrement PK, and make audit's claimed profileId check doesn't exist

evidence.quote:
final insertable = TrackLearningOrderCompanion.custom(
        trackId: const Variable(1),
**Enforcement:** `make audit` flags any user-DB table without a `profileId` column.

why: Both test files in this batch construct TrackLearningOrderCompanion.insert()/.custom() with only trackId/sefariaRef/sortOrder — never profileId — because lib/core/database/tables/track_learning_order.dart has no profileId column at all (confirmed by direct read: bare autoIncrement `id`, only trackId + sefariaRef + sortOrder, uniqueKeys is {trackId, sefariaRef}). Every sibling user-data table in the batch's test evidence (bookmarks, goals, daily_plans, learning_order, streak_events, completion_events, stage_definitions, ...) carries an explicit profileId. Isolation for this table depends entirely on trackId never being confused across profiles; a caching or profile-switch bug elsewhere that reuses a stale trackId would silently read/write another profile's (e.g. a sibling child's) custom text ordering with no schema-level guard to catch it. This gap is currently invisible: `grep -n profileId learning_tracker/Makefile` returns zero matches, so none of the 22 `make audit` checks actually implements the check the standards doc says exists — the rule is marked [E] (Enforced) but enforces nothing for this table.
recommendation: Add a profileId IntColumn (FK to learner_profiles, cascade delete) to TrackLearningOrder, fold it into the uniqueKeys constraint with trackId/sefariaRef, ship it as a schemaVersion bump per DB-4 discipline (migration step + schema export + migration test), and update the DAO. Separately, write the actual `make audit` grep the doc already claims exists so this class of gap is caught mechanically going forward.
acceptance_criteria: lib/core/database/tables/track_learning_order.dart has a profileId column referencing learner_profiles, with a migration step and committed schema export at the new schemaVersion.

A `make audit` check greps every table in lib/core/database/tables/*.dart used by UserDatabase and fails if profileId is absent (unless the table is on a documented content-table exemption list), closing the doc/reality gap at docs/coding-standards.md:689.

corrections: Title's 'the one user_database table with a bare autoincrement PK' overstates uniqueness: accounts.dart, learner_profiles.dart, and sacred_window_entries.dart also have autoIncrement PKs with no profileId column. Those are defensibly out of scope (identity backbone / device-level cache, not per-profile leaf data like TrackLearningOrder's true siblings bookmarks/goals/streak_events which all carry profileId directly), so the core violation and recommendation still stand.
